description: Use when you need recent SEC EDGAR filings for several US public companies at once: up to 10 tickers or CIKs in one POST, each answered exactly like /sec/filings (recent filings with links and key fin. Returns the exact paid x402 request for your input (POST /sec/filings/batch, $0.08 per call), with the response schema and an example; POST that JSON body to the URL with an x402 client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge.

companies.description: 1 to 10 ticker or CIKs; duplicates are removed

form.description: optional, for every company: comma list of form types, e.g. 10-K,10-Q,8-K

limit.description: optional, for every company: filings per form, as in the single call

name: sec_filings_batch
